app.name: SatSaathi
app.tagline: Ask the satellite, in your language
status.onlineHint: Connected. Translation and basemaps are available.
status.offlineHint: Working offline. Everything runs on this machine.
landing.hero.headline: Ask the satellite, in your language.
landing.hero.body: Upload satellite imagery and ask a question in English, Hindi, Tamil or Bangla. Get an answer measured from the pixels, with every step shown.
landing.problem.title: A district officer should not need a remote-sensing degree
landing.problem.body: Flood mapping, crop stress, built-up change: the imagery holds the answer, but reading it means specialist software and specialist training. SatSaathi turns the question into the analysis, and shows its working.
landing.steps.title: What happens when you ask
landing.steps.ask.title: Ask
landing.steps.ask.body: Type or speak your question in your own language. Upload one image, an optical and SAR pair, or a before and after pair.
landing.steps.compute.title: Compute
landing.steps.compute.body: Indices are measured from the pixels themselves. NDVI, NDWI and LSWI are computed on the bands you mapped, never substituted.
landing.steps.explain.title: Explain
landing.steps.explain.body: Every claim is checked against the computed numbers before you see it. Low confidence goes to an expert instead of to you.
landing.steps.act.title: Act
landing.steps.act.body: Take away a report, a GeoJSON layer, and the full execution trace, in the language you asked in.
landing.inputs.title: What you can upload
landing.inputs.single.title: Single image
landing.inputs.single.body: One optical, multispectral or SAR GeoTIFF.
landing.inputs.fusion.title: Optical + SAR pair
landing.inputs.fusion.body: Two co-registered images of the same ground, read together.
landing.inputs.change.title: Before + after pair
landing.inputs.change.body: The same ground on two dates, to measure what changed.
landing.trust.title: You can check the working
landing.trust.body: Every job records what ran, with which parameters, and what it produced. Nothing is asserted that the numbers do not support.

workspace.inputs.title: Imagery
workspace.checks.title: Compatibility
workspace.bands.title: Bands
workspace.bands.presetHint: Pick the sensor so bands are read correctly.
workspace.analyses.title: Available measurements
workspace.analyses.ndviUnavailable: NDVI needs a red and a near-infrared band.
workspace.analyses.ndwiUnavailable: NDWI needs a green and a near-infrared band.
workspace.analyses.lswiUnavailable: LSWI needs a near-infrared and a SWIR band. This sensor has no SWIR.
workspace.map.empty.title: No imagery yet
workspace.map.empty.body: Upload a GeoTIFF and it will be drawn here.
workspace.ask.title: Your question
workspace.ask.voiceUnavailable: Voice questions are not available yet.
workspace.ask.example.single1: Describe the land cover in this image.
workspace.ask.example.single2: How much of this area is under water?
workspace.ask.example.fusion1: Use the optical and SAR images together to identify built-up and water-covered regions.
workspace.ask.example.fusion2: Where does SAR show water that the optical image misses?
workspace.ask.example.change1: What changed between these two dates?
workspace.ask.example.change2: How much paddy was lost to flooding?
workspace.ask.blocked: Upload imagery before asking a question.
workspace.trace.title: What the system did
workspace.trace.subtitle: Every step, in order, with its parameters and what it produced.
workspace.trace.stubHint: This step returns fixture data. The real tool plugs in here later.
steps.ask.title: Question received
steps.ask.body: Reads your question and the language you asked in.
steps.imagery.title: Imagery registered
steps.imagery.body: Reads the GeoTIFF headers: bands, coordinate system, pixel size, footprint, date.
steps.understand.title: Question understood
steps.understand.body: Translates the question to English and works out what is being asked for.
steps.preprocess.title: Imagery prepared
steps.preprocess.body: Calibrates, removes speckle, aligns the images and masks cloud.
steps.compute.title: Measurements computed
steps.compute.body: Computes indices from the pixels and converts pixel counts to area on the ground.
steps.vision_language.title: Imagery read
steps.vision_language.body: Describes what is visible and marks where it is.
steps.verify.title: Claims checked
steps.verify.body: Compares what was described against what was measured, and scores the agreement.
steps.answer.title: Answer written
steps.answer.body: Writes the answer in your language and assembles the report and layers.
answer.title: Answer
answer.confidence.label: Confidence
answer.confidence.high: The description and the measurements agree closely.
answer.confidence.medium: Mostly consistent. Check the flagged area before acting.
answer.confidence.low: The description and the measurements disagree. Sent for expert review.
answer.review.title: Sent for expert review
answer.review.body: Confidence fell below {threshold}%, so this answer is held until a specialist checks it. You will be notified when it is released.
empty.workspace.title: Start with imagery
empty.workspace.body: Upload a GeoTIFF on the left. Once it is read, you can ask a question about it.
error.apiUnreachable.title: Cannot reach the service
error.apiUnreachable.body: The analysis service is not responding. Your uploads are safe.
error.upload.crsMismatch: These two images use different coordinate systems ({a} and {b}). Re-upload them in the same system.
error.upload.notGeoreferenced: This GeoTIFF has no coordinate system, so it cannot be placed on the map.
error.upload.tooLarge: This file is larger than {max} MB.
error.offlineFeature: This needs a connection. Switch out of offline mode to use it.
upload.accepts: PNG, JPEG or WebP. Stays on this machine — nothing is uploaded.
upload.error.unsupported: That file type cannot be displayed. Use PNG, JPEG or WebP.
upload.error.geotiffPreview: GeoTIFF is read on the server; browsers cannot draw one, so the measurements below stand in for a picture.
upload.error.decode: This image could not be read. It may be damaged.
run.limits.title: What this input cannot answer
run.demo.notice: Demo mode. Measurements are computed from your image in the browser; the vision-language and phrasing steps return fixture output.
run.server.notice: Measurements are computed on the server from the file you uploaded. The vision-language and phrasing steps still return fixture output.
answer.noAreaWithoutCrs: This file has no coordinate system, so the area on the ground cannot be derived.
